- Choose-Task startup: read progress, active task summary, and completed task summary.
- .ralph/current_tasks.md contains only the generated header, so there are no active candidate tasks, no blocked tasks to resolve, and no meta-task to select.
- Next: run make check, make test, and make lint as the completion validation gate.

- Completion validation gate passed: make check exited 0, make test exited 0, and make lint exited 0.
- No active tasks exist in .ralph/current_tasks.md, so no path was selected for .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next: touch .ralph/STOP to indicate the migration is complete for now.

- Choose-Task read previous progress, .ralph/current_tasks.md, and .ralph/current_tasks_done.md.
- Active backlog now has multiple unblocked failing non-bug tasks; no unblocked failing bug tasks were present.
- Scanned active task files for <priority> and <blocked_by>; none of the active failing tasks had explicit priority or blocker tags.
- Selected Story 6 Task 1 because centralized config is foundational for later binary, Docker, CI, API, sync, and observability work.
- Next agent should execute .ralph/tasks/story-6-config-unification/task-1-create-config-crate.md using the tdd skill.

- Startup read previous progress and confirmed Story 6 Task 1 was selected by the prior chooser.
- Read AGENTS.md plus tdd and improve-code-boundaries skill instructions.
- Next: read .ralph/current_task.txt and the selected task; branch into planning or NOW EXECUTE based on task state.

- Read current task: .ralph/tasks/story-6-config-unification/task-1-create-config-crate.md.
- Task has no existing plan and no TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE marker, so this is a planning-only pass.
- Inspected Cargo workspace, Makefile, complete-sync/search-sync/opentk-api entrypoints, and existing DatabaseConfig/SearchSyncConfig/SyncFeedClientConfig/ApiConfig shapes.
- Boundary finding: startup config parsing/defaults/validation live in binaries and API default_search_client env reads; plan should centralize file-only config in opentk-config and leave runtime modules with typed configs.
- Next: write the plan file and update the task with the plan path plus NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.

- Created plan file .ralph/tasks/story-6-config-unification/task-1-create-config-crate_plans/centralized-config-crate-plan.md.
- Updated .ralph/tasks/story-6-config-unification/task-1-create-config-crate.md with the plan path and NOW EXECUTE marker.
- Per task instructions, stop now before implementation. Next agent should execute the plan with tdd red/green cycles, then run make check, make lint, and make test before marking passes true.

- Startup read progress, current task, plan, and skill instructions.
- Current task is .ralph/tasks/story-6-config-unification/task-1-create-config-crate.md and marker is NOW EXECUTE.
- Worktree already has unrelated .ralph/task backlog changes; preserve them and implement only current task/code changes.
- Next: inspect existing binary CLI/startup config code, then execute the plan with vertical TDD cycles.

- Inspected Cargo workspace, complete-sync, search-sync, opentk-api binary, API library, search client, DB connect config, and existing tests.
- Boundary problem confirmed: app settings are duplicated across clap env args, DATABASE_URL fallback helpers, hardcoded DB pool settings, and API default_search_client env reads.
- Next: add opentk-config with public parser/loader tests and implementation, then refactor binaries/API to consume it.

- Added crates/opentk-config with typed Config, file loader, TOML parsing, compiled defaults, validation, and deny-unknown-fields behavior.
- Refactored API startup to accept typed database/search config and removed default_search_client env reads.
- Refactored complete-sync and search-sync CLIs to only accept --config for application settings; old per-setting flags are rejected by tests.
- Added source guard test against OPENTK_/DATABASE_URL/dotenvy/std::env::var in production config/startup surfaces.
- Narrow checks green: cargo test -p opentk-config, cargo test -p opentk-api --bin opentk-api, cargo test -p opentk-api --lib, CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p opentk-db --bin search-sync, cargo test -p opentk-db --bin complete-sync.
- Next: run formatting/checks, fix clippy/test failures, update task acceptance, then task_switch/commit/push if all gates pass.

- Full verification passed: make check, make lint, and make test all exited 0.
- Updated task acceptance criteria and plan checkboxes; set Story 6 Task 1 status done and <passes>true</passes>.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, inspect git status, add all files, commit with required message, and push.
